drafted_from: tool:hear-sources row in tools/listen-for-a-while/tool-rows.json and hearSourcesTool in read-data/hearing-sources.mjs (the old tool:hear-sources, computer/mac-tools.json:241-244 at b7dc53d08a)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Hear my call: the microphone recording /Recordings/me.wav and the system-audio recording /Recordings/others.wav, starting at 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00, with the Whisper model I keep at ~/models/ggml-base.bin." It runs tool:hear-sources and tells you each turn in time order, labelled by source.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it hears the recordings handed in and answers the words and the session record; it writes no row and no file, and keeps no recording.
instructions: 1. Have each source's recording as a file on the computer that will hear it, a ggml Whisper model file, and the whisper-cli and ffmpeg programs (or name them).

2. Say "Hear my call with the model <model_path>" and name each source's file. Your AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:hear-sources (sources and model_path are required; whisper_cli, ffmpeg, at and flags are optional).
3. Read the answer: words are the heard segments in time order, each with its source, speaker and me; session is the record (id, program, flags, sources).

worked_examples.title: Two recordings of one call become words in time order, labelled by source
worked_examples.ask: Hear my call: my microphone recording and the system-audio recording, with the model I keep, and tell me who said what.
worked_examples.given: The microphone recording /Recordings/me.wav (the person's own voice) and the system-audio recording /Recordings/others.wav, both heard with the model ~/models/ggml-base.bin on the computer that has whisper-cli.
worked_examples.hands_back: The answer's words hold each heard segment labelled Me (source microphone, me true) or Others (source system-audio, me false), in start-time order; session holds the record with the picked program's id (whisper-cli), the flags and the two sources. A request with no sources is refused with "Give sources"; a request with no model_path with "Give model_path"; a computer with no whisper-cli that runs with "This Mac has no program that hears recordings."
